dominant_failure_attribution: Post-projection smooth spherical rectification under strict anti-leakage regularization (max angular displacement <= 0.25 deg) cannot reach the 25% vertical improvement gate (P95 <= 8.7371 px) on held-out canonical anchors (ROI_01=11.46px, ROI_03=9.68px, Candidate C achieves 10.13px / 13.06% improvement; Candidate D achieves 10.18px / 12.65% improvement). The residual structural bend is physically optical and parallax-driven in 3D camera geometry and cannot be rectified purely via 2D post-projection warping without extreme local distortion or held-out leakage.
